model.jaffle_shop.customers.name: customers
model.jaffle_shop.customers.description: One row per customer with lifetime aggregates (first/last order, total orders, total spend).

customer_id.name: customer_id
customer_id.description: Surrogate primary key for a customer.

first_order_date.name: first_order_date
first_order_date.description: Date of the customer's first order.

most_recent_order_date.name: most_recent_order_date
most_recent_order_date.description: Date of the customer's most recent order.

number_of_orders.name: number_of_orders
number_of_orders.description: Lifetime count of distinct orders placed by this customer.

lifetime_value.name: lifetime_value
lifetime_value.description: Sum of all order revenue for this customer (USD).

model.jaffle_shop.orders.name: orders
model.jaffle_shop.orders.description: One row per order with payment-method splits and the parent customer key.

order_id.name: order_id
order_id.description: Surrogate primary key for an order.

status.name: status
status.description: Lifecycle status: placed, shipped, completed, returned, return_pending.

credit_card_amount.name: credit_card_amount
credit_card_amount.description: Portion of order paid by credit card.

coupon_amount.name: coupon_amount
coupon_amount.description: Portion of order paid by coupon.

bank_transfer_amount.name: bank_transfer_amount
bank_transfer_amount.description: Portion of order paid by bank transfer.

gift_card_amount.name: gift_card_amount
gift_card_amount.description: Portion of order paid by gift card.
